description: Request a mobile dog wash at one of the times from get_available_slots. IMPORTANT: this files a booking REQUEST — the owner confirms it shortly afterward and the customer then receives the confirmation email; tell the user that. Confirm the exact time (Pacific Time), name, email, service address, and dog size before calling. First-time customers can use promo code WASH10 ($10 off) — apply it for them. Fill optional fields from conversation; don't interrogate.

address.description: REQUIRED: the service address where the van comes (street, city).

dog_size.description: Dog size tier — sets the price. Ask weight/breed if unsure (Small <20 lbs, Medium 20–60, Large 60–100, XL/Giant 100+).

email.description: Customer's email (confirmation arrives here after owner approval).

notes.description: Anything else: parking notes, gate codes, coat condition, skunk emergency, behavior notes.

phone.description: Customer's phone — strongly recommended so the owner can reach them.

promo.description: Promo code. Use WASH10 for first-time customers.

start.description: Chosen slot start as a UTC ISO string, exactly as returned by get_available_slots.

name: book_wash
